  "extractions": [
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "A State shall use not less than 90 percent of the funds made available to it under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants for the purposes described in section 9901 of this title to eligible entities.",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "section 9905",
          "9906",
          "section 9901"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F006",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Funds distributed to eligible entities through grants made in accordance with paragraph (1) for a fiscal year shall be available for obligation during that fiscal year and the succeeding fiscal year, subject to paragraph (3).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Funds distributed to eligible entities through grants made in accordance with paragraph (1) for a fiscal year, subject to paragraph (3).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F006"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "paragraph (1)",
          "paragraph (3)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F010",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning on October 1, 2000, a State may recapture and redistribute funds distributed to an eligible entity through a grant made under paragraph (1) that are unobligated at the end of a fiscal year if such unobligated funds exceed 20 percent of the amount so distributed to such eligible entity for such fiscal year.",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "Beginning on October 1, 2000, if unobligated funds distributed to an eligible entity through a grant made under paragraph (1) at the end of a fiscal year exceed 20 percent of the amount distributed to such eligible entity for such fiscal year.",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F010"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "paragraph (1)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F012",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with this paragraph, States shall redistribute such funds to an eligible entity, or require the original recipient of the funds to redistribute the funds to a private, nonprofit organization, located within the community served by the original recipient of the funds, for activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.",
        "actor": "States",
        "actor_quote": "States",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with this paragraph.",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F012"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": "States must either redistribute the funds to an eligible entity, or require the original recipient of the funds to redistribute them to a private, nonprofit organization located within the community served by the original recipient for activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.",
        "choice_quote": "F012",
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F016:F024",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "charity_tax_credit"
        ],
        "statement": "If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants under subsection (a), the State shall use the remainder of the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title (subject to paragraph (2)) for activities that may include providing training and technical assistance to entities in need; coordinating State-operated and, at the State's option, locally-operated programs targeted to low-income children and families with services provided by eligible entities and other funded organizations, including detailing appropriate employees; supporting statewide coordination and communication among eligible entities; analyzing fund distribution to determine targeting to areas of greatest need; supporting asset-building programs for low-income individuals such as individual development accounts; supporting innovative programs conducted by community action agencies or neighborhood-based organizations; supporting State charity tax credits as described in subsection (c); and supporting other activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants under subsection (a).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F016"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "section 9905",
          "9906",
          "subsection (a)",
          "paragraph (2)",
          "subsection (c)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F027",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "No State may spend more than the greater of $55,000, or 5 percent, of the grant received under section 9905 of this title or State allotment received under section 9906 of this title for administrative expenses, including monitoring activities.",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "No State may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "section 9905",
          "section 9906"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F027",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Funds to be spent for administrative expenses shall be taken from the portion of the grant under section 9905 of this title or State allotment that remains after the State makes grants to eligible entities under subsection (a).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "section 9905",
          "subsection (a)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F027",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The cost of activities conducted under paragraph (1)(A) shall not be considered to be administrative expenses.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "exemption",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall not",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "paragraph (1)(A)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F027",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The startup cost and cost of administrative activities conducted under subsection (c) shall be considered to be administrative expenses.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "subsection (c)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F031",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "charity_tax_credit"
        ],
        "statement": "Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit, the State may use for any purpose the amount of the allotment that is available for expenditure under subsection (b).",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit.",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F031"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "paragraph (2)",
          "subsection (b)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F034",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "charity_tax_credit"
        ],
        "statement": "The aggregate amount a State may use under paragraph (1) during a fiscal year shall not exceed 100 percent of the revenue loss of the State during the fiscal year that is attributable to the charity tax credit, as determined by the Secretary of the Treasury without regard to any such revenue loss occurring before January 1, 1999.",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": "During a fiscal year, for amounts used under paragraph (1).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F034"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall not exceed",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "paragraph (1)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F038",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "charity_tax_credit",
        "term_refs": [
          "qualified_charity"
        ],
        "statement": "The term “charity tax credit” means a nonrefundable credit against State income tax (or, in the case of a State that does not impose an income tax, a comparable benefit) that is allowable for contributions, in cash or in kind, to qualified charities.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In subsection (c).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F036"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F040:F046",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "qualified_charity",
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The term “qualified charity” means any organization that is described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title, an eligible entity, or a public housing agency as defined in section 1437a(b)(6) of this title; that is certified by the appropriate State authority as meeting the requirements of clauses (iii) and (iv); and, if such organization is otherwise required to file a return under section 6033 of such title, that elects to treat the information required to be furnished by clause (v) as being specified in section 6033(b) of such title.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In subsection (c).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F036"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": "To qualify, an organization must satisfy three conditions: (1) be either a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt entity, an eligible entity, or a public housing agency; (2) be certified by the appropriate State authority as meeting clauses (iii) and (iv); and (3) if otherwise required to file a return under section 6033, elect to treat information required by clause (v) as specified in section 6033(b).",
        "choice_quote": "F040:F046",
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "section 501(c)(3)",
          "section 501(a)",
          "section 1437a(b)(6)",
          "clauses (iii)",
          "(iv)",
          "section 6033",
          "clause (v)",
          "section 6033(b)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F050",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "collection_organization",
          "qualified_charity"
        ],
        "statement": "A contribution to a collection organization shall be treated as a contribution to a qualified charity if the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "If the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity.",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F050"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F051:F054",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "collection_organization",
        "term_refs": [
          "qualified_charity"
        ],
        "statement": "The term “collection organization” means an organization described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title that solicits and collects gifts and grants that, by agreement, are distributed to qualified charities; that distributes to qualified charities at least 90 percent of the gifts and grants the organization receives that are designated for such qualified charities; and that meets the requirements of clause (vi).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In subsection (c).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F036"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "section 501(c)(3)",
          "section 501(a)",
          "clause (vi)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F058",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "An organization meets the requirements of clause (iii) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the predominant activity of such organization will be the provision of direct services within the United States to individuals and families whose annual incomes generally do not exceed 185 percent of the poverty line in order to prevent or alleviate poverty among such individuals and families.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "clause (iii)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F060",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "An organization shall not be required to establish or maintain records with respect to the incomes of individuals and families for purposes of subclause (I) if such individuals or families are members of groups that are generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I).",
        "actor": "organization",
        "actor_quote": "organization",
        "kind": "exemption",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "scope_text": "For purposes of subclause (I), if individuals or families are members of groups generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F060"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall not be required",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "subclause (I)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F061:F065",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I), services to individuals in the form of donations of food or meals, or temporary shelter to homeless individuals, shall be treated as provided to individuals described in subclause (I) if the location and provision of such services are such that the service provider may reasonably conclude that the beneficiaries of such services are predominantly individuals described in subclause (I).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I), if the location and provision of services in the form of donations of food or meals, or temporary shelter to homeless individuals, are such that the service provider may reasonably conclude that beneficiaries are predominantly individuals described in subclause (I).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F061",
          "F065"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "subclause (I)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F068",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "poverty_program_expense"
        ],
        "statement": "An organization meets the requirements of clause (iv) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the annual poverty program expenses of such organization will not be less than 75 percent of the annual aggregate expenses of such organization.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "clause (iv)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F071",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "poverty_program_expense",
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "For purposes of subclause (I), the term “poverty program expense” means any expense in providing direct services referred to in clause (iii).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "For purposes of subclause (I).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F069"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "subclause (I)",
          "clause (iii)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F074",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": [
          "poverty_program_expense"
        ],
        "statement": "The term poverty program expense shall not include any management or general expense, any expense for the purpose of influencing legislation (as defined in section 4911(d) of title 26), any expense for the purpose of fundraising, any expense for a legal service provided on behalf of any individual referred to in clause (iii), any expense for providing tuition assistance relating to compulsory school attendance, and any expense that consists of a payment to an affiliate of the organization.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": "For purposes of subclause (I).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F069"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall not include",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "section 4911(d)",
          "clause (iii)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F078:F079",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The information required to be furnished under clause (v) about an organization is the percentages determined by dividing expenses for direct services, management expenses, general expenses, fundraising expenses, and payments to affiliates by the total expenses of the organization for the year; and the category or categories (including food, shelter, education, substance abuse prevention or treatment, job training, or other) of services that constitute predominant activities of the organization.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Under clause (v).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F077"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "required",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "clause (v)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F081:F083",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The requirements of clause (vi) for collection organizations are met if the organization maintains separate accounting for revenues and expenses, and makes available to the public information on the administrative and fundraising costs of the organization and information as to the organizations receiving funds from the organization and the amount of such funds.",
        "actor": "organization",
        "actor_quote": "organization",
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "For collection organizations under clause (vi).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F081"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "clause (vi)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F085:F091",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In the case of a State that has a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and that, as of December 31, 1997, imposed a tax on personal income with a single flat rate applicable to all earned and unearned income (except insofar as any amount is not taxed pursuant to tax forgiveness provisions) and no generally available exemptions or deductions to individuals, the requirement of paragraph (2) shall be treated as met if the amount of the credit described in paragraph (2) is limited to a uniform percentage (but not greater than 25 percent) of State personal income tax liability (determined without regard to credits).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In the case of a State that has a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and that, as of December 31, 1997, imposed a tax on personal income with a single flat rate applicable to all earned and unearned income (except insofar as any amount is not taxed pursuant to tax forgiveness provisions) and no generally available exemptions or deductions to individuals.",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F085:F089"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "paragraph (2)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F094",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2), no part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to pay for the cost of the startup and administrative activities conducted under subsection (c).",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": "Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2).",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F094"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "no part ... may be used",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": [
          "subsection (b)(2)",
          "paragraph (1)",
          "subsection (c)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F097",
      "unit_attributes": {

unit_attributes.statement: A State shall use not less than 90 percent of the funds made available to it under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants for the purposes described in section 9901 of this title to eligible entities.

Funds distributed to eligible entities through grants made in accordance with paragraph (1) for a fiscal year shall be available for obligation during that fiscal year and the succeeding fiscal year, subject to paragraph (3).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Funds distributed to eligible entities through grants made in accordance with paragraph (1) for a fiscal year, subject to paragraph (3).

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning on October 1, 2000, a State may recapture and redistribute funds distributed to an eligible entity through a grant made under paragraph (1) that are unobligated at the end of a fiscal year if such unobligated funds exceed 20 percent of the amount so distributed to such eligible entity for such fiscal year.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning on October 1, 2000, if unobligated funds distributed to an eligible entity through a grant made under paragraph (1) at the end of a fiscal year exceed 20 percent of the amount distributed to such eligible entity for such fiscal year.

unit_attributes.statement: In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with this paragraph, States shall redistribute such funds to an eligible entity, or require the original recipient of the funds to redistribute the funds to a private, nonprofit organization, located within the community served by the original recipient of the funds, for activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with this paragraph.
unit_attributes.choice_text: States must either redistribute the funds to an eligible entity, or require the original recipient of the funds to redistribute them to a private, nonprofit organization located within the community served by the original recipient for activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.

unit_attributes.statement: If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants under subsection (a), the State shall use the remainder of the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title (subject to paragraph (2)) for activities that may include providing training and technical assistance to entities in need; coordinating State-operated and, at the State's option, locally-operated programs targeted to low-income children and families with services provided by eligible entities and other funded organizations, including detailing appropriate employees; supporting statewide coordination and communication among eligible entities; analyzing fund distribution to determine targeting to areas of greatest need; supporting asset-building programs for low-income individuals such as individual development accounts; supporting innovative programs conducted by community action agencies or neighborhood-based organizations; supporting State charity tax credits as described in subsection (c); and supporting other activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants under subsection (a).

unit_attributes.statement: No State may spend more than the greater of $55,000, or 5 percent, of the grant received under section 9905 of this title or State allotment received under section 9906 of this title for administrative expenses, including monitoring activities.

Funds to be spent for administrative expenses shall be taken from the portion of the grant under section 9905 of this title or State allotment that remains after the State makes grants to eligible entities under subsection (a).
The cost of activities conducted under paragraph (1)(A) shall not be considered to be administrative expenses.
The startup cost and cost of administrative activities conducted under subsection (c) shall be considered to be administrative expenses.

Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit, the State may use for any purpose the amount of the allotment that is available for expenditure under subsection (b).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit.

unit_attributes.statement: The aggregate amount a State may use under paragraph (1) during a fiscal year shall not exceed 100 percent of the revenue loss of the State during the fiscal year that is attributable to the charity tax credit, as determined by the Secretary of the Treasury without regard to any such revenue loss occurring before January 1, 1999.
unit_attributes.scope_text: During a fiscal year, for amounts used under paragraph (1).

unit_attributes.statement: The term “charity tax credit” means a nonrefundable credit against State income tax (or, in the case of a State that does not impose an income tax, a comparable benefit) that is allowable for contributions, in cash or in kind, to qualified charities.

The term “qualified charity” means any organization that is described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title, an eligible entity, or a public housing agency as defined in section 1437a(b)(6) of this title; that is certified by the appropriate State authority as meeting the requirements of clauses (iii) and (iv); and, if such organization is otherwise required to file a return under section 6033 of such title, that elects to treat the information required to be furnished by clause (v) as being specified in section 6033(b) of such title.
unit_attributes.choice_text: To qualify, an organization must satisfy three conditions: (1) be either a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt entity, an eligible entity, or a public housing agency; (2) be certified by the appropriate State authority as meeting clauses (iii) and (iv); and (3) if otherwise required to file a return under section 6033, elect to treat information required by clause (v) as specified in section 6033(b).

unit_attributes.statement: A contribution to a collection organization shall be treated as a contribution to a qualified charity if the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity.

unit_attributes.statement: The term “collection organization” means an organization described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title that solicits and collects gifts and grants that, by agreement, are distributed to qualified charities; that distributes to qualified charities at least 90 percent of the gifts and grants the organization receives that are designated for such qualified charities; and that meets the requirements of clause (vi).

An organization meets the requirements of clause (iii) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the predominant activity of such organization will be the provision of direct services within the United States to individuals and families whose annual incomes generally do not exceed 185 percent of the poverty line in order to prevent or alleviate poverty among such individuals and families.

An organization shall not be required to establish or maintain records with respect to the incomes of individuals and families for purposes of subclause (I) if such individuals or families are members of groups that are generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I).
unit_attributes.scope_text: For purposes of subclause (I), if individuals or families are members of groups generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I).

unit_attributes.statement: Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I), services to individuals in the form of donations of food or meals, or temporary shelter to homeless individuals, shall be treated as provided to individuals described in subclause (I) if the location and provision of such services are such that the service provider may reasonably conclude that the beneficiaries of such services are predominantly individuals described in subclause (I).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I), if the location and provision of services in the form of donations of food or meals, or temporary shelter to homeless individuals, are such that the service provider may reasonably conclude that beneficiaries are predominantly individuals described in subclause (I).

unit_attributes.statement: An organization meets the requirements of clause (iv) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the annual poverty program expenses of such organization will not be less than 75 percent of the annual aggregate expenses of such organization.
For purposes of subclause (I), the term “poverty program expense” means any expense in providing direct services referred to in clause (iii).

The term poverty program expense shall not include any management or general expense, any expense for the purpose of influencing legislation (as defined in section 4911(d) of title 26), any expense for the purpose of fundraising, any expense for a legal service provided on behalf of any individual referred to in clause (iii), any expense for providing tuition assistance relating to compulsory school attendance, and any expense that consists of a payment to an affiliate of the organization.

The information required to be furnished under clause (v) about an organization is the percentages determined by dividing expenses for direct services, management expenses, general expenses, fundraising expenses, and payments to affiliates by the total expenses of the organization for the year; and the category or categories (including food, shelter, education, substance abuse prevention or treatment, job training, or other) of services that constitute predominant activities of the organization.

The requirements of clause (vi) for collection organizations are met if the organization maintains separate accounting for revenues and expenses, and makes available to the public information on the administrative and fundraising costs of the organization and information as to the organizations receiving funds from the organization and the amount of such funds.

In the case of a State that has a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and that, as of December 31, 1997, imposed a tax on personal income with a single flat rate applicable to all earned and unearned income (except insofar as any amount is not taxed pursuant to tax forgiveness provisions) and no generally available exemptions or deductions to individuals, the requirement of paragraph (2) shall be treated as met if the amount of the credit described in paragraph (2) is limited to a uniform percentage (but not greater than 25 percent) of State personal income tax liability (determined without regard to credits).
unit_attributes.scope_text: In the case of a State that has a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and that, as of December 31, 1997, imposed a tax on personal income with a single flat rate applicable to all earned and unearned income (except insofar as any amount is not taxed pursuant to tax forgiveness provisions) and no generally available exemptions or deductions to individuals.

unit_attributes.statement: Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2), no part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to pay for the cost of the startup and administrative activities conducted under subsection (c).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2).

unit_attributes.statement: No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to provide legal services or to provide tuition assistance related to compulsory education requirements (not including tuition assistance for tutoring, camps, skills development, or other supplemental services or training).

No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to supplant non-Federal funds that would be available, in the absence of Federal funds, to offset a revenue loss of the State attributable to a charity tax credit.
